notes: Lines 79-82: `guard let java = chunker.resolveJavaPath(...) else { throw .javaNotFound }` runs strictly before `guard chunker.isInstalled else { throw .jarNotInstalled }`. When both are false (a fresh install with neither Java nor the Chunker jar configured yet), the error the user sees is javaNotFound even though jarNotInstalled is equally true -- the port must preserve this exact precedence since it changes which error message/remediation the UI shows first.
